title: Minimum fasteners.
officialText:
Round metallic ducts shall be mechanically fastened by means of at least three sheet metal screws or
rivets spaced equally around the joint.
Exception: Where a duct connection is made that is partially inaccessible, three screws or rivets shall be equally spaced on the
exposed portion so as to prevent a hinge effect.
